caption: The switch on a wall-mounted heater is flipped, and its indicator light comes on and its fan starts.

sa.check: A heater mounted on a wall, with a switch.
The light is off and the fan still before the flip.
The order is flip, then light and fan together.

pc.expect: The light comes on and the fan starts together at the moment the switch is flipped, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is flipped and neither light nor fan responds to the end of the clip; or the light comes on while the fan stays still to the end; or the fan runs while the light stays dark; or the fan starts before the switch moves.

pc.expect: Before the flip the fan is still; afterwards it runs steadily and does not stop, start or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: The fan stops and restarts with the switch untouched; or turns slowly by itself before the flip; or reverses direction; or the heater rocks on the wall.

pc.expect: Light items in the heater's airflow flutter once the fan runs and are still before.
pc.fail: Curtains or paper near the outlet flutter before the fan starts; or nothing in the airflow moves while the fan runs; or the flutter blows toward the heater.
pc.precondition: Light items such as curtains, paper or tassels are in front of the heater's outlet.

pc.expect: Once on, the light stays lit and the fan keeps running while the switch stays on.
pc.fail: The light goes out again with the switch on; or flickers; or the switch flips back by itself; or the fan slows to a stop with the switch on.

pc.expect: One heater fixed to the wall; it keeps its shape and place; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The heater drops off the wall or moves along it; or a second heater appears; or the hand passes into the heater; or the grille changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The heater's colour, its grille and the wall stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The heater changes colour; or the grille pattern changes; or the wall changes colour.

note: The fan may be hidden behind the grille; it is judged from visible blade motion or the movement of items in its airflow.
